# TikZ Graph in Markdown

Here is a simple graph drawn with TikZ:

\begin{tikzpicture}[>=stealth, node distance=2cm]
  \node (A) [circle, draw] {A};
  \node (B) [circle, draw, right of=A] {B};
  \node (C) [circle, draw, below of=A] {C};
  \node (D) [circle, draw, below of=B] {D};

  \draw[->] (A) -- (B);
  \draw[->] (A) -- (C);
  \draw[->] (B) -- (D);
  \draw[->] (C) -- (D);
\end{tikzpicture}

---

## Using the `graphs` library

\begin{tikzpicture}
  \graph [spring layout, nodes={circle, draw}] {
    a -- b -- c -- d -- a,
    a -- c,
    b -- d
  };
\end{tikzpicture}
